nodes.name: Start (CSV Import)
nodes.notes: Primary path. Run this to ingest a pre-built lead CSV (e.g. an Outscraper Google Maps export) instead of scraping fresh.

nodes.name: Read Leads CSV
nodes.notes: Parses the CSV named by LEADS_CSV_PATH into one item per row. Handles quoted fields containing commas.

nodes.name: Map CSV to Lead Schema
nodes.notes: Leads that already have an email (Outscraper enrichment) go straight to email_found, skipping Hunter.io in workflow 02. Leads without one stay at scraped so 02 can attempt to find one (only if a website exists).

nodes.name: Start (Apify — Optional)
nodes.notes: Optional/legacy path for scraping a fresh city from Google Maps when you don't already have a CSV. Not required for normal operation.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ searchStringsArray: ($env.APIFY_SEARCH_TERMS || 'tree service').split('|'), maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch: Number($env.APIFY_MAX_PER_SEARCH) || 100, language: 'en', includeWebResults: false }) }}

nodes.name: Start Apify Scraper
nodes.notes: Starts the Apify Google Maps Scraper actor. Search terms and region now come from APIFY_SEARCH_TERMS (pipe-separated) in .env instead of being hardcoded.

nodes.name: Check Apify Error
nodes.notes: Routes Apify errors to the alert node

nodes.name: Fetch Scraper Results
nodes.notes: Fetches the dataset items from the last Apify run

nodes.name: Clean & Filter Leads
nodes.notes: Extracts name, website, address, rating, phone, category. No-website leads are kept (see task: no-website businesses are the primary target).

nodes.name: Save to Google Sheet
nodes.notes: Appends each lead. Sheet 'Leads' tab needs columns: name, website, address, rating, phone, category, business_status, reviews, email, status. Shared by both the CSV and Apify paths.

nodes.name: Summary
nodes.notes: Outputs a summary of how many leads were saved, regardless of which path fed it

parameters.subject: ⚠️ Cold Email Pipeline — Apify Scraper Failed

nodes.name: Send Error Alert
nodes.notes: Sends an error alert email if the Apify scraper fails (non-200 response). Replace credential ID with your Gmail OAuth2 credential.
